caption: The worked example end to end: 4,000 lines over 20 reviewer-hours is 200 lines per hour, 24 total defects over 4 KLOC is 6 per KLOC, and the review caught 20 of those 24, so effectiveness is 83.33%. The last number divides by all 24 defects, not just the 20 the review found.

spec.title: Worked example: review metrics
spec.aria: A 4,000-line module inspected over 20 reviewer-hours gives a rate of 200 lines per hour, 24 total defects over 4 KLOC give a density of 6 per KLOC, and catching 20 of 24 defects gives 83.33% effectiveness.
